description: Records what ACTUALLY happened on an experiment day: `followed` true or false (did the user do what that day's arm said), with an optional note. Only intervention and control days can be logged (not washout or unassigned days), not future days and not after the experiment was stopped. `date` defaults to today; `id` defaults to the one experiment running today (needed when none or several run). Logging a day again with a different answer keeps the earlier answer under `earlier` (nothing is lost); the same answer again changes nothing. analyze_experiment reports intention to treat (every assigned day) and per protocol (only days logged as followed), so honest logging, including false, matters. Local file only (experiments.json): never contacts Suunto, needs no credentials. Output: { id, date, arm, saved: { followed, note, loggedAt, earlier }, changed }. Not read-only, not destructive, idempotent.

date.description: The day, YYYY-MM-DD (default today; not in the future).

followed.description: true: the user did what that day's arm said. false: they did not.

id.description: The experiment id (default: the one running today).

name: log_experiment_day
title: Log what actually happened on an experiment day
